Events we cater

Every event gets a named event lead who visits the venue with you before the day.

Weddings

Canapés during photos, a sit-down dinner and late night snacks.

Usually 60 to 200 guests

Office lunches

Boxed lunches or a hot buffet, set up before your meeting starts.

Usually 20 to 120 guests

Parties

Birthdays, anniversaries and graduations at home or in a hired hall.

Usually 30 to 100 guests

Conferences

Breakfast, lunch and coffee breaks across one or several days.

Usually 100 to 400 guests

Work out your price

Choose a package, set your guest count and add extras. The total updates as you go. Prices include food, delivery and setup.

    Sample menus

    These change with the seasons. We can cook for vegan, gluten-free, halal and nut-free guests at no extra cost.

    Canapé reception

    • Beet and goat cheese tartlets
    • Chicken satay with peanut sauce
    • Smoked trout on rye
    • Mushroom arancini
    • Mini lemon meringue pies

    Family-style feast

    • Slow roast lamb shoulder with herbs
    • Chicken with lemon and olives
    • Roast squash and farro salad
    • Warm focaccia and whipped butter
    • Charred greens with chilli

    Plated dinner

    • Burrata, peach and basil
    • Beef sirloin, potato, red wine sauce
    • Or wild mushroom risotto (vegan option)
    • Dark chocolate tart with cream

    Ask for a quote

    Tell us about your event. You'll hear back from an event lead within 48 hours with a full menu and a fixed price.

    "They fed 140 people at our wedding in a field with no kitchen. Hot food, on time, and they left the barn cleaner than they found it."
    Wedding couple, Boulder, June

# Catering

Creator: mmrahmanbappi
Source: https://github.com/mmrahmanbappi/100-free-html-templates/blob/bab6ec6c8900450aab90989d217942a67ad9b16d/restaurant/catering/index.html

Extract the ZIP and open index.html. No build, npm dependencies or remote CDN is required.

The upstream/ folder preserves original source with its MIT notice. Root index.html is the separately documented MigBits adaptation.

Replace fictional sample business content, connect your own backend and retain the included license notices. Forms, data and payments are demonstrations.

Use Pause motion or your operating system reduced-motion preference. Full production and accessibility review remains your responsibility.

Original single-file HTML/CSS/inline JavaScript retained separately with creator MIT notice.

Stock photography, external fonts, favicons, metadata and remote services are excluded from the runnable edition; original HTML references are preserved as text only.

Original MigBits geometric demo artwork and motion controls are separate adaptations. Forms and checkout are frontend demonstrations, not backend services.

No React conversion is claimed. System font fallback changes the upstream typography. Render validation is not a complete accessibility audit.

Mobile grid minimum widths and word wrapping are corrected for community-center and nonprofit-charity. Dynamic photo references and initially empty image viewers use original artwork.

The original download-promotion toolbar is removed from runnable pages; creator attribution and complete copyright notices remain. Photo credit labels reflect the replacement MigBits artwork.

Use Pause motion or your operating system reduced-motion preference. Full production and accessibility review remains your responsibility.

dependencies: Native browser APIs; no package dependencies
